name: none_or_not_acquired
definition: No usable evidence for this product claim, or the source is not yet acquired.

name: upstream_context
definition: Applicability, boundary-state, component, or model-input evidence only.
allowed_claim_language: Informed by or consistent with the source; product not validated.

name: indirect_feature_or_envelope
definition: A proxy, relative shape, band result, feature, or envelope constrains part of the product.
allowed_claim_language: Externally baselined for the named feature/envelope only.

name: quantitative_after_measurement_operator
definition: Provider output is transformed through an explicit experiment-equivalent operator and quantitatively scored.
allowed_claim_language: Quantitatively validated for the named observable, operator, and domain.

name: direct_native_product_observable
definition: The experiment directly measures the same product quantity with matching semantics, units, and coordinates.
allowed_claim_language: Directly validated for the named product quantity and domain.
